facts.notes: TCM engine letter is only one part of control-module hardware/software matching; identical four-letter housings are not automatically swappable.

issues.title: MY2009 9-5 VIN source actually lists 2010 codes; wrong-year decode would select incorrect parts
issues.cause: SaabWISOnline workshop directory year 2009 hosts a VIN table explicitly saying A=2010 and only 5-door/K-L trim; the named year and in-document production mapping disagree.
symptoms: seller claims MY2009 using an unverified WIS model-year decoder
trim/body or transmission VIN coding conflicts with an actual car
issues.diagnosis_summary: Read actual body stamped and windshield VIN, establish official registration/title data, then verify correct original factory VIN definition and build through authoritative Saab WebEPC.
issues.correction_summary: Do not use the 2009 WIS-mirrored VIN table as MY2009 decoder; retain year-mapping gap until proper primary source is recovered.
limits: The source mismatch does not establish a fraudulent VIN or that a real 2009 car is not authentic.
Directory 2009 is NOT publication/model-year authority for the page.
No vehicle VIN was provided or decoded.

issues.title: NG9-3 gearbox and chassis tags are necessary before ordering a donor drivetrain or suspension parts
issues.cause: Saab factory 9440 manuals distinguish FA57 five-speed automatic, AF40 six-speed automatic, and F40 six-speed manual plus multiple 5MT coding variants; chassis options determine front strut side/parts.
symptoms: seller says only automatic or manual, without gearbox stamping
donor transmission/TCM or front strut offered by year/trim alone
issues.diagnosis_summary: Record VIN, original body/engine type and physical transmission type stamping, TCM hardware/software identity and suspension code row; validate current Saab WebEPC for exact sides and revisions.
issues.correction_summary: Apply model-specific transmission fluid and service procedure only after physical identification. Do not approve a part interchange without OE manufacturer filter, interfaces and software/hardware compatibility.
limits: Year folder 2006 AF40 type page refers to MY2005; this is documentation existence, not universal MY2006 population.
Historical GM part 13106944 on AF40 tag example is not a replacement fitment approval.
Suspension code row alone is not a unique left/right part number.
